reused_evidence.scope: frozen pins of all 18 shared files plus their artifact _meta, including the null _meta of these eight
the ninth PoBR-owned option file, which does carry a hand-curated _meta; introduced by 59f46c05

residual_limits: The artifact carries no _meta for these eight, so a reader of the data alone cannot see the owning commit; the map exists only in this proposal and would need the registry entry to persist.

Their option semantics are this engine's explicit assumptions (no event timeline), not game-table facts; energy options are embedded at extraction time, so editing the file requires re-running the config-options extractor.
They are not covered by any acquisition_acceptance and must not be described as target-patch game data.

reused_evidence.scope: 15 drifted fixed ranges, each with exactly one exact-FNV whole-window match in bb52d6b3; frozen file untouched
buff check exit 1 with the 15 drift lines; parser check exit 0 'no drift detected' plus closure/count warnings
the same facts stated as a root correction

residual_limits: The maintained buff check still exits 1. The relocation shows the recorded text still exists at new line ranges; it does not prove semantic equivalence and does not authenticate upstream. Do not report the check as passing and do not rewrite the frozen refs in this pass.

The parser check exits 0 but prints closure-inference failures and pinned-count mismatches (forms 95 vs 91, name_map 795 vs 775, tag_phrases 700 vs 687, ...). Exit 0 is 'no drift against the committed artifact', not semantic certification.

high_precision_mods loads but its precision-exception branch is not wired to any calculation yet (its _meta says 零接线); local_mods values are PoBR's own predicate rather than a vendor table; special_mods mixes two bases by entry and cannot be labelled with one game source.
Two vendor commits (ce8bffab, 2df5a743) are recorded while the repository reference pin is bb52d6b3; reconciling them is a separate maintenance step.
